description: On the tabletop in front of you there’s a small mound of light green slime with white foam beads, with a clear plastic cap and a tiny white piece sitting off to the upper left. The left hand and right hand move in toward the slime and make it a two-hand object, pinching and lifting it slightly, then squeezing, folding, and stretching it between the hands before pressing it back down and continuing to knead it with small pulls and compressions.
